title: ^CYBERSECURITY CAPSTONE PROJECT
description: Utilize foundational knowledge of cybersecurity to complete a cybersecurity operations project. Develops skills for project development, including project planning, requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, configuration management, quality assurance, documentation, and delivery.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CS 424 and (WR 327, 327H, 227Z or 227HZ).
A minimum grade of C is required in CS 424, WR 327, WR 327H, WR 227Z and WR 227HZ.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Cybersecurity (004).

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
